user.title: Connect to qBittorrent
user.description: Enter the connection details for your qBittorrent Web UI.

reauth_confirm.title: Reauthenticate qBittorrent
reauth_confirm.description: The connection to qBittorrent needs to be re-authenticated.

error.banned: qBittorrent's brute-force protection has temporarily banned this connection after too many failed login attempts, even though your credentials may be correct. Restart qBittorrent (this usually clears the ban) or wait, then try again. You can adjust or disable this in qBittorrent under Tools → Options → Web UI → Enable brute-force protection.
error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect to qBittorrent. Check the host, port and network path.

abort.already_configured: This qBittorrent instance is already configured.

data.max_torrents_in_attributes: Maximum torrents in the torrent list sensor's attributes

unsupported_version.title: Unsupported qBittorrent version
unsupported_version.description: The connected qBittorrent instance runs a version that is not fully supported by this integration ({error}). Most functionality should still work, but you may see errors for some entities or services.

add_torrent.name: Add torrent
add_torrent.description: Add one or more torrents by magnet/URL or by uploading a .torrent file.

delete_torrents.name: Delete torrents
delete_torrents.description: Remove one or more torrents, optionally deleting their files.

pause_torrents.name: Pause torrents
pause_torrents.description: Pause (stop) one or more torrents. Use 'all' to pause every torrent.

resume_torrents.name: Resume torrents
resume_torrents.description: Resume (start) one or more torrents. Use 'all' to resume every torrent.

recheck_torrents.name: Recheck torrents
recheck_torrents.description: Force a hash recheck of one or more torrents.

reannounce_torrents.name: Reannounce torrents
reannounce_torrents.description: Force one or more torrents to reannounce to their trackers.

force_start.name: Force start
force_start.description: Enable or disable force start for one or more torrents.

set_auto_management.name: Set automatic torrent management
set_auto_management.description: Enable or disable automatic torrent management for one or more torrents.

set_super_seeding.name: Set super seeding
set_super_seeding.description: Enable or disable super seeding for one or more torrents.

increase_priority.name: Increase priority
increase_priority.description: Increase the queue priority of one or more torrents.

decrease_priority.name: Decrease priority
decrease_priority.description: Decrease the queue priority of one or more torrents.

top_priority.name: Top priority
top_priority.description: Move one or more torrents to the top of the queue.

bottom_priority.name: Bottom priority
bottom_priority.description: Move one or more torrents to the bottom of the queue.

set_location.name: Set location
set_location.description: Move one or more torrents' files to a new location.

set_save_path.name: Set save path
set_save_path.description: Set the save path for one or more torrents.

set_category.name: Set category
set_category.description: Assign a category to one or more torrents.

add_tags.name: Add tags
add_tags.description: Add one or more tags to one or more torrents.

remove_tags.name: Remove tags
remove_tags.description: Remove one or more tags from one or more torrents.

set_share_limits.name: Set share limits
set_share_limits.description: Set ratio, seeding time and inactive seeding time limits for one or more torrents.

set_upload_limit.name: Set torrent upload limit
set_upload_limit.description: Set the upload speed limit for one or more torrents.

set_download_limit.name: Set torrent download limit
set_download_limit.description: Set the download speed limit for one or more torrents.

set_file_priority.name: Set file priority
set_file_priority.description: Set the download priority of specific files within a torrent.

export_torrent.name: Export torrent
export_torrent.description: Export a torrent's .torrent file as base64-encoded content.

remove_categories.name: Remove categories
remove_categories.description: Delete one or more torrent categories.

set_speed_limits_mode.name: Set alternative speed limits mode
set_speed_limits_mode.description: Enable or disable the alternative global speed limits.

set_global_download_limit.name: Set global download limit
set_global_download_limit.description: Set the global download speed limit.

set_global_upload_limit.name: Set global upload limit
set_global_upload_limit.description: Set the global upload speed limit.

ban_peers.name: Ban peers
ban_peers.description: Ban one or more peers by host:port.

set_preferences.name: Set application preferences
set_preferences.description: Set one or more raw qBittorrent application preference keys.

rss_remove_item.name: Remove RSS item
rss_remove_item.description: Remove an RSS folder or feed.

rss_set_rule.name: Set RSS auto-download rule
rss_set_rule.description: Create or update an RSS auto-downloading rule.

search_get_results.name: Get search results
search_get_results.description: Retrieve results for a search job.

get_torrents.name: Get torrents
get_torrents.description: Retrieve the full, optionally filtered, list of torrents (use this to look up hashes).

get_app_preferences.name: Get application preferences
get_app_preferences.description: Retrieve all current qBittorrent application preferences.

create_torrent.name: Create torrent
create_torrent.description: Create a new .torrent file from content on the qBittorrent host (best-effort; newest part of the API).
